name: Spectraformer: Random Feature Linear Attention with Flexible Kern
description: Spectraformer: Random Feature Linear Attention with Flexible Kernel Approximation. Replaces softmax attention with random orthogonal feature projections, enabling true linear O(N·r·d) time and memory complexity.  Production-Hardened with: - Multi-architecture copy_weights (GPT-2, RoBERTa/BERT nested, Qwen/LLaMA, DistilBERT) - Frobenius norm validation (>= 1e-4) - Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) with
math_latex: W \approx U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top = A B^\top, \quad r \ll \min(d_{in}, d_{out})

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

math: c^{KV}_t = W^{DKV} x_t, \quad k^C_t = W^{UK} c^{KV}_t, \quad v^C_t = W^{UV} c^{KV}_t
